bind_addr.description: IP address to bind fingerd server to (e.g., 127.0.0.1, 0.0.0.0)

port.description: TCP port number for finger service

enable_mail_lookup.description: Enable mail status lookup (mailboxes checked at query time)

show_plan.description: Include contents of ~/.plan file in long-format responses

show_project.description: Include contents of ~/.project file in long-format responses

show_pgpkey.description: Include contents of ~/.pgpkey file in long-format responses

hide_user_nofinger.description: Ignore .nofinger file and always respond for all users (disable privacy protection)

allowed_clients.description: List of IP addresses or hostnames allowed to query this finger daemon; empty means allow all (insecure).
